destinationLock.longTable: Long-table recordings share one table with the other long-table recordings in the same schema, so the destination is fixed after saving.
destinationLock.boundTable: This recording is bound to its table, so the destination is fixed after saving.

policy.mixedHiddenNote: Intervals are set per point; incomplete rows are fixed to partial results; managed-table duplicate protection, entity key and provenance columns are system-defined.

preparation.unsavedManagedNote: Save the configuration before checking the table structure.

catalog.error: Could not reach the destination database (could not read the table list). Check the connection and retry; your entries are preserved.

legacyMethod.label: Latest (legacy wide table)
legacyMethod.createWithPoints: Create new recording with these points

readinessIssue.schema-confirmation-required: The table structure has not been confirmed and applied. Check and confirm it before starting recording.
readinessIssue.write-group-apply-required: The recording is saved but not yet applied to the database and runtime.
readinessIssue.database-target-missing: No database recording target exists for this point yet.
readinessIssue.source-revision-stale: The source point or rule has changed; save this recording again.
readinessIssue.schema-check-blocked: Resolve the blocking issues above before checking the table structure.

instantaneousMethod.meanConsentTitle: Confirm before switching to arithmetic mean
instantaneousMethod.intervalInvalid: Enter a whole number of seconds from {{min}} to {{max}}.
instantaneousMethod.pendingNote: Saving creates a new version of this recording. Check and confirm the table structure again in the preparation area before recording uses it; data already recorded is not recalculated.
instantaneousMethod.rejected: The gateway could not save these settings. Your changes are kept and not applied. Check the recording settings, source points and interval, then try again.
